name: aiflowchart
description: Create flowcharts, sequence diagrams, mind maps, ER, UML and architecture diagrams from plain English or code, and open them as editable boards in AI Flowchart.

interface.longDescription:
AI Flowchart turns a description or a piece of code into a clean, editable diagram.

Ask for a flowchart, sequence diagram, mind map, ER diagram, system design, swimlane, BPMN process, org chart, UML (class, use case, state, activity), timeline, Gantt chart or data chart. You get a preview card in the chat and a link that opens the diagram as a board in AI Flowchart, where you can edit it, present it as a slideshow, or export PNG, PDF or PowerPoint.

Code to flowchart: paste a short program (C, C++, Java, Python or JavaScript, up to 80 lines) to get a flowchart linked to its code lines plus a step-by-step dry run.

Without signing in you can browse ready-made templates and turn Mermaid text into a hosted PNG/SVG image. Creating diagrams with AI needs a free AI Flowchart account and uses one AI credit per diagram; some diagram types need an AI Flowchart Pro account.

AI Flowchart only creates new diagrams. It cannot read, change or delete your existing boards.
capabilities: Code to flowchart with dry run
defaultPrompt: Make a flowchart of a password reset flow
Draw a sequence diagram for a login with OAuth
Turn this Python function into a flowchart

positive.description: Create a flowchart from a description (signed-in test account)
positive.prompt: Make a flowchart of how a user resets a forgotten password.
positive.expected_behavior: A diagram card shows the flowchart title, a preview image and an Open in AI Flowchart button; the text reply includes the aiflowchart.io/import link and Mermaid code.

positive.prompt: Draw a sequence diagram for a user logging in with Google OAuth to a web app and its API.
positive.expected_behavior: A sequence diagram with user, web app, Google and API participants is created; the card shows a preview and the link opens it as an editable board.

positive.description: Turn code into a flowchart with a dry run
positive.expected_behavior: A flowchart of the function is created with a step-by-step dry run; the reply reports the output 120 and the link opens the board ready to play.

positive.description: Browse and open a template (works without signing in)
positive.prompt: Show me AI Flowchart's ER diagram templates and open one for a library management system.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists ER diagram templates, then returns a card and link that opens the chosen template as a new editable board.

positive.description: Render Mermaid as an image (works without signing in)
positive.prompt:
Render this Mermaid as a PNG I can paste into an email:
flowchart TD
  A[Order placed] --> B{Paid?}
  B -- yes --> C[Ship]
  B -- no --> D[Send reminder]
positive.expected_behavior: Returns hosted PNG and SVG URLs from img.aiflowchart.io with Markdown and HTML snippets; the card shows the rendered image.

negative.description: Not a diagram request: the plugin should not be used
Editing or deleting existing boards is not supported
negative.prompt: Delete all my AI Flowchart boards.

negative.description: Code longer than the supported limit
negative.prompt: Make a flowchart of this 500-line Java program: (paste of a very long file)

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: create diagrams from text, code to flowchart with dry run, templates, and Mermaid to PNG/SVG, with an inline diagram card.
